scripts.build: sh -c 'sh ./select-python.sh -m venv .venv && .venv/bin/python -m pip install --upgrade pip && .venv/bin/python -m pip install -r requirements.txt'
scripts.typecheck: sh -c 'PYTHON_BIN=.venv/bin/python3; if [ ! -x "$PYTHON_BIN" ]; then PYTHON_BIN=python3; fi; PYTHONPYCACHEPREFIX=/tmp/readymeet-pyc exec "$PYTHON_BIN" -m compileall meeting_agent run.py'
scripts.lint: sh -c 'PYTHON_BIN=.venv/bin/python3; if [ ! -x "$PYTHON_BIN" ]; then PYTHON_BIN=python3; fi; PYTHONPYCACHEPREFIX=/tmp/readymeet-pyc exec "$PYTHON_BIN" -m compileall meeting_agent run.py'
